status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% more than the week before, most of them in Bamako, Niamey and Mopti.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Bamako, Niamey og Mopti.

summary.en: Armed men attacked civilians heading to market in western Niger, killing at least 37 people. Rival jihadist groups JNIM and ISSP intensified clashes in northern Burkina Faso. Ukrainian officers are training Sahel militants on drone use. In northern Nigeria, violence forced tens of thousands of civilians to flee into Niger and opposition leader Atiku accused President Tinubu of failing Nigerians after 638 people were killed and 64,000 fled. The war produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Bevæpnede menn angrep sivile på vei til markedet i vestlige Niger, og drepte minst 37 personer. Rivaliserende jihadistgrupper JNIM og ISSP intensiverte kamper i nordlige Burkina Faso. Ukrainiske offiserer trener Sahel-militante i bruk av droner. I nordlige Nigeria tvang vold titusenvis av sivile til å flykte til Niger, og opposisjonslederen Atiku anklaget president Tinubu for å svikte nigerianerne etter at 638 personer ble drept og 64 000 flyktet. Krigen førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known as the Sahel War, is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. The conflict mainly takes place in the countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
